verdict.rationale: Kit documents a public V4 API with API-key and OAuth 2.0 authentication (including PKCE, refresh, and revocation flows), cursor pagination, bulk/async processing, and endpoint references for broadcasts, custom fields, and accounts, so a user can drive the product programmatically. An llms.txt is also served for AI consumption. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed OpenAPI paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: We support two authentication mechanisms in the V4 API: OAuth 2.0 for apps available for all creators in the Kit App Store, API keys for automating simple tools and integrations for your own account
Our API offers a host of functionality to help our creators automate a bunch of tasks
you will be able to create and send broadcasts to your subscribers, manage your email list through tags and custom fields, import purchase data from your favourite e-commerce platforms
All of our list endpoints are paginated unless noted otherwise, using cursor based pagination.
Draft or schedule to send a broadcast to all or a subset of your subscribers
